title: Same Origin, Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian
abstract: arXiv:2611.05385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights

translated_title: 同源不同判：文本生产条件混淆俄语机器生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 机器生成文本的自动检测被应用于判定结果会给作者带来实际代价的场景，然而“来源”是生产过程的属性，而非文本本身可观察的属性。文本生产时所处的条件会将文本推向与生成模型被假定为推向的相同方向。本研究在保持来源不变的前提下测量这些条件的贡献。该俄语语料库共包含1882篇文档：机器部分由四个生成通道（各自依托不同的模型家族）在三种任务模式下的45个任务中生成；人类部分来自档案文献，并在阅读文本之前预先标注了来源规约化程度。主要对比在机器语料库内部进行：文本对的两半由同一模型针对同一任务生成，仅在任务措辞上存在差异。机器相似度通过四种操作化方式进行测量，其中包括一个带权重的可解释指数……
tldr: 该研究利用同一模型、同一任务下仅任务措辞不同的文本对进行对比，证明文本生产条件本身（而非文本真实来源）即可显著影响俄语机器生成文本检测的判定结果。
